sourceSentences.text: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz was published in 1900 by L. Frank Baum.

This ebook was produced for Standard Ebooks by Michael Atkinson, and is based on a transcription produced in 1993 by Distributed Proofreaders for Project Gutenberg and on digital scans from the Internet Archive.
The cover page is adapted from Heroic Landscape with Rainbow, a painting completed in 1824 by Joseph Anton Koch.
